learning_outcomes.text: Students master mathematical techniques: Horner's scheme, Gaussian elimination method, vector operations, projection, derivatives and integration of elementary functions, substitution, logical transformations.
They understand mathematical concepts: vector space, analytical geometry, derivatives, integration.
They know applications and acquire skills in applying mathematical results.
Students possess abilities in presenting results by lecturing the solutions to exercises.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals: Sets, propositional logic, number ranges, Horner's scheme
Linear equations: Gaussian elimination method, uniqueness of solution
Linear algebra: Scalar product, vector product, cross product, vector space
Analytical geometry: Lines in plane/space, plane in space, intersections and intersection angles
Differential calculus of functions of one variable: Sequences, limit, continuity, derivative
Circular and hyperbolic functions, exponential and logarithmic functions
Integral calculus: Definite and indefinite integrals, integral and antiderivative, integration by parts, integration by substitution, integration of rational functions
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for receiving credit points is passing the module examination. Active participation in the exercises is a prerequisite for taking the exam. The grade is weighted according to credit points.
